variants.headline: Still in view: party leader faces a challenge
variants.sub: A challenge to a party leader has opened in the colony.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. A party's leader is being challenged in {colony}.

The position of {target} deserves scrutiny without assuming that a challenge is either justified or doomed. The existence of a contest is the known fact on which this account rests.

variants.headline: Still in view: leadership becomes a contested question
variants.sub: The leadership of a political party is under challenge.
variants.body:
This story remains under examination, {months_running} months into our coverage of the original event. A challenge to a party leader has opened in the colony.

The position of {target} deserves scrutiny without assuming that a challenge is either justified or doomed. The existence of a contest is the known fact on which this account rests.
